title: Natural unit-module tensor-section coordinates
statement: For every scheme X, the associated etale sheaf of the unit O_X-module [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module] admits additive section coordinates b_U with values Gamma(U,O_U), natural under etale restrictions. If theta has components Gamma(U,u^*(multiplication by r)) for a global function r, then b_U(theta_U(x)) = b_U(x) u^*(r). This statement concerns sections and sheaf morphisms only, not cohomology.

source.place: Tags 0096 and 01CA, pullback of the unit; Tag 03DR, equation (35.8.1).

proof.text: Use the top-open component of epsilon_u as the canonical additive coordinate map. Its bijectivity follows from tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit_isIso. The normalized restriction equation gives naturality by evaluating its equality of additive homomorphisms at the section.

Apply the tensor adjunction Hom equivalence to pullback of multiplication by r followed by epsilon_u, and epsilon_u followed by multiplication by u-sharp(r). Naturality of the Hom equivalence, pushforward_map_smulHom, and smulHom_naturality identify their images. Injectivity gives equality of module maps. Evaluate at the top open, use the stipulated components of theta, and commute the two scalar factors.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_etaleTensorUnit_sections_natural (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    ∃ b : ∀ U : X.Etaleᵒᵖ,
        (etaleTensorSectionsSheaf (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).obj.obj U ≃+
          Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤),
      (∀ (U V : X.Etaleᵒᵖ) (g : U ⟶ V)
          (x : (etaleTensorSectionsSheaf (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).obj.obj U),
        b V ((etaleTensorSectionsSheaf (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).obj.map g x) =
          g.unop.left.appTop (b U x)) ∧
      (∀ (r : Γ(X, ⊤))
          (θ : etaleTensorSectionsSheaf (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) ⟶
            etaleTensorSectionsSheaf (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)),
        (∀ U : X.Etale, θ.hom.app (Opposite.op U) =
          ((tensorPullback U.hom).map (smulHom (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) r)).app ⊤) →
        ∀ (U : X.Etaleᵒᵖ)
          (x : (etaleTensorSectionsSheaf (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).obj.obj U),
          b U (θ.hom.app U x) =
            b U x * (show Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤) from U.unop.hom.appTop r))
